camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainRealTimeBpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn telecom --EndTime '2019-11-30T05:40:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2019-11-30T05:33:00Z'
description_en: Queries bandwidth data for one or more accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRealTimeBpsData查询加速域名的带宽数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-real-time-bps-data --domain-name example.com --isp-name-en telecom --location-name-en beijing --start-time 2019-11-30T05:33:00Z --end-time 2019-11-30T05:40:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainRealTimeBpsData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,).

You can specify up to 500 domain names in each request
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。

一次最多可以传500个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query ISPs. If you do not set this parameter, all ISPs are queried
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获取。不传该参数默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query regions. If you do not set this parameter, all regions are queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获取。不传该参数默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

TimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp of the data returned. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
TimeStamp.description_zh: 数据时间戳。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间
